about.metaDescription: The mission and vision behind ABPL, the first professional city-based badminton league in the United States.
about.heroIntro: Badminton is one of the most-played sports on earth, yet it's never had a true home in America. ABPL was created to change that. By building city-based franchises, we're giving communities a team to call their own and giving world-class athletes a stage worthy of their talent. This is more than a league — it's the beginning of badminton's American era.
about.quote: One city. One team. One fanbase at a time — built from the very first season of American badminton.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Give Badminton a Home in America.
mission.body: ABPL's mission is to build professional badminton in America — one city, one team, one fanbase at a time. We're recruiting elite athletes, launching franchises, and creating the venues and broadcasts a real league needs. And we're doing it with the people who show up early — the fans, cities, and partners who help build this from the very first season.

vision.label: Our Vision
vision.title: A Franchise In Every Major City.
vision.body: We see a future where badminton fills arenas across the country — where kids growing up in American cities have a hometown badminton team to call their own. ABPL is building toward a league where American-developed talent competes at the highest level, where Season One marks the start of a permanent home for the sport, and where "Badminton Built for America" isn't just a statement — it's the standard we're judged by.

league.metaTitle: League Info — American Badminton Premier League
league.metaDescription: The founding story and league format of ABPL, the first professional city-based badminton league in the United States.
league.storyQuote: Badminton is one of the most electric, fastest-growing sports in the world — and in 2025, it finally found its home in America. ABPL was founded to give this sport the professional stage it's always deserved: a city-based, franchise-driven league built from the ground up, for the athletes who play it and the fans who love it.
league.storyBody: This is Season One — the very beginning. The cities, the franchises, the rosters are coming together right now, and this page will grow with every announcement. Getting in at the start means watching something real take shape, one milestone at a time.
league.note: Exact team counts, cities, and rules are still being finalized.

items.title: City-Based Franchises
items.description: Each franchise represents its own city, building a true home fanbase — the same model that's made America's biggest leagues thrive.

items.title: Professional Roster, Draft-Built
items.description: Franchises are stocked with top American and international badminton talent through a structured player draft and signing process.

items.title: Regular Season
items.description: Franchises face off across a home-and-away regular season, with team-format matches spanning singles, doubles, and mixed doubles.

items.title: Playoffs & Championship
items.description: Top franchises advance to a playoff bracket, culminating in a championship final to crown Season One's champion.
